clips.title: The story
paras: Near Ambermill, Kirin Tor mages carry Dalaran Mana Gems to replenish their power. Forsaken tailors use the gems to weave enchanted robes.

Kirin Tor mages, conjurors, and guards around Ambermill carry mana gems to focus and replenish their arcane power. In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Forsaken practitioners prize the gems as a ready supply of concentrated magic. Some undead mages share an academic heritage with Dalaran, but survival comes first. To the Forsaken, the Kirin Tor are rivals whose magical stores can be taken.

Forsaken bring mana gems taken from fallen Kirin Tor operatives to tailors such as Josef Gregorian in the Undercity, along with simple linen. A tailor cannot channel arcane power directly, but can bind a gem into the cloth. The magic then strengthens the wearer’s connection to the arcane.
